system.summary: Lope Hurtado's 1522 system: Latin-trigram code groups plus a homophonic letter alphabet of cursive signs (see lopehurtado/).
system.notes: Identified by the recurring code groups ton/zar/xul/rab/tu/yub/top/taf; not applied line by line.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Fetched the DECODE record and six images; the f. 376v docket names Lope Hurtado, Rome, December; the cipher shows Lope Hurtado's code groups (ton, zar, xul, rab).

Fetched Bergenroth CSP Spain ii December 1522 (pp. 510-519) and grepped Salazar A. 26: no. 510 = ff. 371-377, Lope Hurtado to the Emperor, 23 Dec 1522, 'Autograph in cipher. Contemporary deciphering.'

outcome.notes: DECODE sender (Jeronimo Adorno?), recipient and date corrected. Nothing new read. Catalogue entry 145 removed; DECODE correction queued; no write-up.
